properties.name: jeap.governance.prometheus.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable the Prometheus integration

properties.name: jeap.governance.prometheus.amp.query-lookback
properties.description: How far back the Prometheus queries look for the most recent sample of a service. Must be a positive duration. Keep it longer than a deployment takes, so that rules do not fail for a service that is temporarily not scraped, and short enough for the rules to reflect a changed service configuration quickly.
